sites.name: Tree Of Heaven Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $15 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: In the 1800s, Chinese immigrants lived and farmed on this stretch of flat land along the Klamath River. They sold vegetables to the miners and worked in the local mines. They imported a homeland tree called the Tree of Heaven to remind them of their native land. Today the Tree of Heaven Campground…
sites.directions: From I-5 west on Hwy 96 approx. 7 miles to the campground on the left and down the hill.
sites.restrictions: Dogs on leash only. Please clean up after your dog. Camping limit 14 days.
sites.accessibility: Some campsites are accessible to wheelchairs with assistance. There is a concrete ramp to the river. Some tables and restrooms will accommodate wheelchairs…
